account-locked: Akaunti yatsekedwa kwakanthawi chifukwa cha zoyesa kulowa zolephera zambiri. Chonde yesaninso pambuyo pake.
cloud-panel-not-allowed: Cloud Panel ndi ya SuperAdmin yekha, pa Domeni ya Cloud Panel.
cloud-settings-desc: Ndi WeKan mu Weddy, Cloud Panel imatumikira madomeni ambiri a WeKan kuchokera pa seva imodzi, iliyonse ndi deta yake. Pa Domeni ya Cloud Panel, SuperAdmin amayang'anira madomeni ndi CloudFlare.
cloud-superadmin-username: Dzina la wogwiritsa ntchito la SuperAdmin
cloudflare-api-key-desc: Ndi kiyi ya CloudFlare API, domeni yomwe zone yake ili mu akaunti yanu ya CloudFlare imalandira rekodi ya DNS yodutsa pa proxy ndi satifiketi ya CloudFlare Origin. Madomeni ena amalandira satifiketi ya Let's Encrypt. Kiyi imasungidwa pa seva ndipo siidzawonetsedwanso.
cloudflare-api-key-not-set: Palibe kiyi ya CloudFlare API yosungidwa: domeni iliyonse imalandira satifiketi ya Let's Encrypt.
